title: Testimonial Card Generator
description: Create a styled testimonial card — quote, author, star rating — with live preview and copy-ready HTML/CSS.
howto: Type the quote, author name and role/company.
Set the star rating and pick an accent color and card style.
Copy the code or download the self-contained testimonial.html.

faqs.q: How are the avatar initials made?
faqs.a: Automatically from the author name — the first letters of the first two words.
The generator uses full stars from 1–5 for clean, copy-ready markup.
Yes — the card is fluid and caps at a readable max width.

faqs.q: Can I embed it in an existing page?
faqs.a: Copy the markup and the <style> block; all classes are prefixed with tm- to avoid collisions.
